passages.title: 放手的那一刻
passages.text: Learning to ride a bike was not {1} for me. I was eight years old, and I was afraid of falling. Every afternoon, Dad held the back of my seat and ran beside me for {2} an hour. "Don't look down," he kept saying. "Look straight ahead." One windy afternoon, at the very {3} I started to feel brave, he quietly let go. I didn't know! I rode all the way {4} the fruit shop and the temple at the end of our street. When I finally looked back, Dad was far behind me, waving his arms and shouting, "You did it!" I was so surprised that I fell into a bush. My knees hurt, but I was laughing. It was the best {5} of my childhood: sometimes you can do much more than you think.

blanks.why: not easy「不容易」：我很怕跌倒，學騎車不容易。dead、past、half 放在 was not 後面形容學騎車都不通。
half an hour「半小時」：爸爸每天陪我跑半小時。piece、date、group 都不能接 an hour 表示時間長度。
at the moment + 子句「在…的那一刻」：就在我開始覺得勇敢的那一刻，他放手了。lesson、date、piece 都不能這樣用。
ride past + 地方「騎過…」：我一路騎過水果店和廟。than、because、during 都不能接地方表示「經過」。
the best lesson「最棒的一課」，冒號後面說明學到的道理。piece、half、group 都不能接「學到的道理」。

passages.zh: 學騎腳踏車對我來說並不容易。那時我八歲，很怕跌倒。每天下午，爸爸都扶著我的座椅後面，在我旁邊跑半小時。「不要往下看，」他一直說，「看前面。」一個風很大的下午，就在我開始覺得勇敢的那一刻，他悄悄放了手。我完全不知道！我一路騎過街尾的水果店和廟。等我終於回頭，爸爸已經在我後面很遠的地方，揮著手大喊：「你做到了！」我嚇了一大跳，摔進了灌木叢裡。膝蓋很痛，但我笑個不停。那是我童年學到最棒的一課：有時候你能做到的，比你想像的多很多。

passages.title: 化石裡的恐龍蛋
passages.text: Dinosaurs disappeared about sixty-six million years ago. They lived in the distant {1}, long before people. Last Friday, our class visited a science museum to learn about them. In the first room, a guide showed us a {2} of a real dinosaur egg. It looked like a gray stone with cracks. Then she divided our class into four {3}. Each group had to dig for fossils in a big sandbox with small brushes. It wasn't {4} at all. We had to be very careful, or the "bones" might break. After forty minutes, my group found a plastic dinosaur tooth, and we screamed like we had found treasure. On the bus home, I told my friends, "My {5} is to find a real dinosaur bone one day." My friend laughed. "Then you'd better start digging in your backyard."

blanks.why: the distant past「遙遠的過去」：恐龍活在很久以前。piece、group、moment 都不能接在 the distant 後面表示「很久以前」。
a piece of…「一塊…」：一塊真正的恐龍蛋化石。group of a real egg（一顆蛋不能是一群）、date、lesson of an egg 都不通。
divide … into groups「把…分成幾組」。pieces、dates、lessons 不能用來分班上的同學。
not easy「不容易」：要很小心，不然骨頭會斷。dead、past 放在這裡形容挖化石都不通；own 不能單獨放在 wasn't 後面。
My dream is to…「我的夢想是…」。date、piece、half 都不能接 is to find 表示想做的事。

passages.zh: 恐龍大約在六千六百萬年前消失。牠們活在遙遠的過去，比人類早了很久很久。上星期五，我們班去科學博物館認識恐龍。第一間展覽室裡，導覽員給我們看一塊真正的恐龍蛋化石，它看起來像一顆有裂縫的灰色石頭。接著她把我們班分成四組，每組要用小刷子在一個大沙箱裡挖化石。這一點也不容易，我們必須非常小心，不然「骨頭」可能會斷掉。四十分鐘後，我們這組挖到一顆塑膠恐龍牙齒，大家尖叫得好像挖到寶藏一樣。回家的遊覽車上，我跟朋友說：「我的夢想是有一天能找到真正的恐龍骨頭。」朋友笑著說：「那你最好開始挖你家後院。」

passages.title: 分西瓜的方法
passages.text: Last Sunday, Mom bought a big watermelon and asked my brother to cut it in {1}. As usual, my brother and sister started to fight about who would get the bigger {2}. "Mine is smaller!" my sister cried. "No, it isn't!" my brother shouted. Mom listened to them for a minute. Then she came up with an {3} way to stop the fight. "This time, one person cuts, and the other person chooses first," she said. For a {4}, my brother just stood there and thought about it. Then he picked up the knife and cut very, very slowly. He measured the watermelon with a ruler three times! In the end, the two parts looked exactly the same, and nobody complained. I learned a {5} that day: when you know someone else will choose first, you try hard to be fair.

blanks.why: cut … in half「切成兩半」。piece 要用複數 in pieces；group、date 都不能接在 cut it in 後面。
the bigger piece「比較大的那一塊」：兄妹在搶大塊的西瓜。date、lesson、dream 都不能說西瓜的大小。
an easy way「一個簡單的方法」：媽媽想到停止吵架的簡單辦法。dead、past、able way 意思都不通。
for a moment「一下子、片刻」：哥哥站著想了一下。lesson、date、group 不能接在 for a 後面表示短時間。
learn a lesson「學到一課、得到教訓」，冒號後面說明道理。piece、date、dream 都不能和 learn 這樣搭配表示學到道理。

passages.zh: 上星期天，媽媽買了一顆大西瓜，叫哥哥把它切成兩半。跟平常一樣，哥哥和妹妹開始吵誰可以拿比較大的那一塊。「我的比較小！」妹妹大叫。「才沒有！」哥哥吼回去。媽媽聽了一分鐘，想到一個簡單的方法讓他們不再吵：「這次一個人切，另一個人先選。」哥哥站在那裡想了一下，接著拿起刀，非常、非常慢地切。他還拿尺把西瓜量了三次！最後，兩半看起來一模一樣，沒有人再抱怨。那天我學到一課：當你知道別人會先選，你就會很努力地做到公平。

passages.title: 奶奶日曆上的紅圈
passages.text: Grandma keeps a big paper calendar on the kitchen wall. On it, she circles important {1} in red, like birthdays and doctor visits. Last week, I noticed a red circle on March 3, but no one in our family has a birthday then. "What's this day, Grandma?" I asked. She looked at it for a {2} and smiled. "That's the day I met your grandpa," she said. "We went to see a movie together. It was our first {3}." Even though Grandpa has been {4} for five years, Grandma still cooks his favorite fish soup on that day. Every year, she also invites a small {5} of old friends to share it with her. They tell stories about Grandpa and laugh a lot. This year, I helped her cook, and she let me write my own name on the calendar, too.

blanks.why: important dates「重要的日子」：生日、看醫生的日子。pieces、groups、halves 都不能在日曆上圈起來。
for a moment「一下子」：奶奶看了一下才笑。piece、half、group 不能接在 for a 後面表示短時間。
our first date「我們的第一次約會」：一起去看電影。piece、half、group 都不能表示「約會」。
has been dead for…「已經過世…年」。easy、half、own 放在這裡意思都不通。
a small group of…「一小群…」：奶奶邀請幾位老朋友。piece、date、half of old friends 都不能用來說「一群人」。

passages.zh: 奶奶在廚房牆上掛了一本大大的紙月曆，她會用紅筆把重要的日子圈起來，像是生日和看醫生的日子。上星期，我發現三月三日被圈了起來，但我們家沒有人那天生日。「奶奶，這天是什麼日子？」我問。她看了一下，笑了。「那是我認識你爺爺的日子，」她說，「我們一起去看電影，那是我們的第一次約會。」雖然爺爺已經過世五年了，奶奶每年那天還是會煮他最愛的魚湯，也會邀請幾位老朋友一起來喝。大家講著爺爺的故事，笑得很開心。今年我幫奶奶一起煮，她還讓我在月曆上寫下自己的名字。

passages.title: 變成起司的夢
passages.text: Last night, I had the strangest {1} of my life. In it, I was a {2} of cheese sitting on a kitchen table. Suddenly, a huge mouse with a red hat jumped onto the table and looked at me hungrily. I rolled off the table and ran. I ran {3} the fridge, under the sofa, and into my sister's room. The mouse followed me everywhere. Finally, I hid inside one of my old shoes. Just at the {4} the mouse found me and opened its mouth, my alarm clock rang. I sat up in bed, breathing hard. Then I looked at the clock. It was already 7:30, {5} an hour later than usual! I jumped out of bed and ran to school even faster than I ran in my dream. And for lunch, I didn't eat my cheese sandwich.

blanks.why: have a dream「做夢」：昨晚做了一個最奇怪的夢。date、piece、lesson 都不能和 have 搭配表示做夢。
a piece of cheese「一塊起司」。group、date、half 都不能這樣接 of cheese 表示「一塊」。
run past + 地方「跑過…」：我跑過冰箱旁邊。than、because、during 都不能接地方表示「經過」。
at the moment + 子句「就在…的那一刻」：老鼠張嘴的那一刻鬧鐘響了。lesson、date、piece 都不能這樣用。
half an hour「半小時」：比平常晚了半小時。piece、group、date 都不能接 an hour 表示時間。

passages.zh: 昨晚我做了這輩子最奇怪的夢。夢裡，我是一塊放在廚房桌上的起司。突然，一隻戴紅帽子的巨大老鼠跳上桌子，飢餓地看著我。我滾下桌子拚命跑，跑過冰箱、鑽過沙發下面，衝進妹妹的房間，老鼠一路緊追不放。最後，我躲進一隻舊鞋子裡。就在老鼠找到我、張開嘴巴的那一刻，我的鬧鐘響了。我從床上坐起來，大口喘氣。接著我看了看時鐘，已經七點半了，比平常晚了半小時！我跳下床跑去上學，跑得比夢裡還快。而那天午餐，我沒有吃我的起司三明治。

passages.title: 跟不熟的同學一組
passages.text: In English class, our teacher put us into {1} of four for a project. I wasn't happy because I didn't know anyone in my group very well. The project looked {2} at first: make a poster about a famous place in Taiwan. But we soon found it wasn't. Everyone had a different idea, and we spent {3} of our time arguing. One wanted Taipei 101, another wanted Sun Moon Lake, and I wanted Kenting. Then a quiet boy named Kai said, "Why don't we put all of them on a map? Let's each do one {4} of the work." Kai drew the map, I wrote the English, and the others found photos. In the end, our poster won first place! I learned an important {5}: you don't need to know people well to work well with them. Now Kai and I eat lunch together every day.

blanks.why: groups of four「四人一組」。pieces、dates、halves 都不能用來分組。
look easy「看起來簡單」，後面說「但很快發現不是」。dead、past 用來形容作業都不通；own 不能單獨放在 looked 後面。
spend half of … time「花一半的時間」：我們一半時間都在吵。piece、date、group of our time 意思都不通。
one piece of the work「一部分工作」：每個人負責一部分。date、lesson、dream of the work 都不通。
learn an important lesson「學到重要的一課」，冒號後說明道理。half、group、dream 都不能接「學到的道理」。

passages.zh: 英文課時，老師讓我們四人一組做專題。我不太開心，因為組員我都不熟。一開始作業看起來很簡單：做一張介紹台灣名勝的海報。但我們很快就發現沒那麼簡單。每個人想法都不同，我們花了一半的時間在吵架：有人想做台北101，有人想做日月潭，我想做墾丁。這時，一個叫 Kai 的安靜男生說：「我們何不把它們全放在一張地圖上？每個人負責一部分。」Kai 畫地圖，我寫英文，其他人找照片。最後，我們的海報得了第一名！我學到重要的一課：不需要跟人很熟，也能一起合作得很好。現在我和 Kai 每天都一起吃午餐。

passages.title: 手機沒電的一天
passages.text: Last Saturday, I forgot to charge my phone, and it was {1} by noon. That afternoon, I was going to visit my friend's new home for the first time. Without a map on my phone, it wasn't {2} to find my way. All the streets looked the same! Finally, I walked into a park and asked a {3} of old men who were playing chess under a tree. One of them knew the street. He took out a pen and drew a map for me on a {4} of paper. "Turn left at the temple and walk past the school," he said. I followed his map carefully and got to my friend's house {5} an hour late. My friend laughed when I showed her the hand-drawn map. "This is better than any app," she said. I still keep it in my desk.

blanks.why: dead「（電池）沒電的」：手機到中午就沒電了。easy、half、own 放在這裡形容手機都不通。
It wasn't easy to…「做…不容易」：沒有手機地圖很難找路。dead、own、past 都不能用在這個句型。
a group of + 人「一群…」：一群在下棋的老伯伯。piece、date、half of old men 都不能表示一群人。
a piece of paper「一張紙」。group、date、lesson of paper 都不通。
half an hour late「晚了半小時」。piece、date、group 都不能接 an hour 表示時間。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我忘了幫手機充電，到中午它就沒電了。那天下午，我要第一次去朋友的新家。手機沒有地圖，要找路一點都不容易，每條街看起來都一樣！最後，我走進一座公園，問一群在樹下下棋的老伯伯。其中一位知道那條街，他拿出筆，在一張紙上幫我畫了地圖。「在廟那裡左轉，經過學校就到了。」他說。我小心地照著地圖走，晚了半小時才到朋友家。我拿出那張手畫地圖給她看，她笑著說：「這比任何應用程式都好用。」我到現在還把它收在書桌裡。

passages.title: 小學四年級的日記
passages.text: Yesterday, while I was cleaning my room, I found my old diary from fourth grade. Reading about my {1} was so much fun. On the first page, I wrote that my {2} was to become a dinosaur when I grew up. I really believed it was possible! On another page, I wrote about the {3} I lost my first tooth in a bowl of noodles. I even drew a picture of the tooth. Between two pages, I found a small {4} of paper. It was a note from my best friend at that time: "Let's be friends forever." We haven't talked for years. Back then, life seemed so {5}. My biggest problems were spelling tests and green peppers. That night, I sent my old friend a message. She answered in five minutes. "I still have your note, too!"

blanks.why: my past「我的過去」：讀日記就是讀自己以前的事。piece、group、half 都不能這樣用。
My dream was to…「我的夢想是…」。date、piece、half 都不能接 was to become 表示想做的事。
the moment + 子句「…的那一刻」：我在麵碗裡掉第一顆牙的那一刻。lesson、piece、group 都不能這樣用。
a small piece of paper「一小張紙」。group、date、half of paper 都不通。
easy「輕鬆的、簡單的」：那時最大的煩惱只是拼字考和青椒。dead、half 形容生活不通；own 不能單獨放在 seemed so 後面。

passages.zh: 昨天整理房間時，我找到小學四年級的舊日記。讀著自己以前的事真的好好玩。第一頁上我寫著，我的夢想是長大以後變成恐龍，我那時真的相信這是可能的！另一頁上，我寫了第一顆牙齒掉進麵碗裡的那一刻，還畫了那顆牙的圖。在兩頁中間，我發現一小張紙條，是我當時最好的朋友寫的：「我們永遠當朋友。」我們已經好幾年沒說話了。那時候的生活看起來好簡單，最大的煩惱只是拼字考和青椒。那天晚上，我傳了訊息給那位老朋友，她五分鐘就回了：「我也還留著你的紙條！」

passages.title: 下半場的大逆轉
passages.text: In the first {1} of the basketball final, our team was losing by twenty points. When we walked off the court, nobody said a word. In the locker room, our coach looked at each of us. "Winning won't be {2}," he said, "but it's possible if we play as a team." Then he drew a new plan on a {3} of paper. In the second half, we passed the ball more and stopped trying to score alone. Little by little, the other team's lead got smaller. With ten seconds left, we were behind by two points. Jay got the ball and threw it from far away. At the very last {4}, it went in. Three points! We won by one. The whole school ran onto the court. I learned a {5} that day: never give up until the game is over.

blanks.why: the first half「上半場」。piece、date、lesson 都不能表示比賽的上半段。
won't be easy「不會容易」，後面說「但是有可能」。dead、past 放在這裡都不通；own 不能單獨放在 be 後面。
a piece of paper「一張紙」：教練在紙上畫新戰術。group、date、moment of paper 都不通。
at the last moment「在最後一刻」：最後一刻球進了。piece、group、date 都不能表示時間點。
learn a lesson「學到一課」，冒號後面說明道理。date、piece、half 都不能接「學到的道理」。

passages.zh: 籃球決賽的上半場，我們隊落後二十分。走下球場時，沒有人說話。在休息室裡，教練看著我們每一個人說：「要贏不會容易，但只要我們像一個團隊一樣打，就有可能。」接著他在一張紙上畫了新的戰術。下半場，我們多傳球，不再只想自己得分。對手的領先一點一點縮小。最後十秒，我們落後兩分。Jay 拿到球，從很遠的地方出手。就在最後一刻，球進了，三分！我們贏了一分。全校的人都衝進球場。那天我學到一課：比賽結束前，永遠不要放棄。

passages.title: 缺一片的拼圖
passages.text: During winter vacation, my family worked on a puzzle with a thousand {1}. It was a picture of Taipei 101 at night. It wasn't {2} because so many pieces were dark blue and looked the same. Every evening after dinner, we sat around the table and worked on it. We spent {3} a month on it. On the last night, we were very excited, but then we found that one piece was missing! For a {4}, nobody spoke. We looked under the table, in the sofa, and even in the trash. Then my little brother slowly opened his hand. He had hidden the last piece in his pocket for days. His {5} was to put the last piece in by himself. We all laughed and let him do it. Now the finished puzzle is hanging on our living room wall.

blanks.why: a thousand pieces「一千片」：一千片的拼圖。groups、dates、lessons 都不能說拼圖有幾片。
not easy「不容易」：很多片都是深藍色，看起來一樣。dead、past 形容拼圖都不通；own 不能單獨放在 wasn't 後面。
half a month「半個月」：我們花了半個月拼。piece、date、group 都不能接 a month 表示時間長度。
for a moment「一時之間」：大家一下子都說不出話。lesson、date、group 不能接在 for a 後面表示短時間。
His dream was to…「他的夢想（心願）是…」：弟弟想自己放最後一片。date、half、group 都不能接 was to put 表示想做的事。

passages.zh: 寒假期間，我們全家一起拼一幅一千片的拼圖，圖案是台北101的夜景。這一點也不容易，因為很多片都是深藍色，看起來都一樣。每天晚飯後，我們圍坐在桌子旁一起拼，總共花了半個月。最後一晚，大家都很興奮，卻發現少了一片！一時之間，沒有人說話。我們找了桌子底下、沙發縫，甚至連垃圾桶都翻了。這時，弟弟慢慢張開他的手。原來他把最後一片藏在口袋好幾天了，他的心願是自己放上最後一片。我們都笑了，讓他放了上去。現在完成的拼圖就掛在我們家客廳的牆上。

passages.title: 兔子警官茱蒂
passages.text: In the movie Zootopia, a little rabbit named Judy Hopps has one big {1}: to become a police officer in the big city. But it isn't {2} for a small rabbit. All the other officers are huge animals like elephants, lions, and rhinos, and nobody believes she can do the job. On her first day, the chief doesn't give her a real case. Instead, he makes her give out parking tickets. Judy doesn't give up. Later, she meets a clever fox named Nick, and together they work on a case about missing animals. They spend {3} the night driving around the city and looking for clues. At the {4} they find the answer, everyone finally believes in Judy. The movie teaches an important {5}: anyone can be anything, no matter how big or small they are.

blanks.why: have a dream「有一個夢想」，冒號後面說明夢想內容。date、piece、half 都不能接「想成為警察」。
isn't easy for…「對…來說不容易」：小兔子要當警察不容易。dead、past 放在這裡都不通；own 不能單獨放在 isn't 後面。
half the night「半個晚上」：他們花了半個晚上在城裡找線索。piece、date、group the night 都不通。
at the moment + 子句「在…的那一刻」。lesson、date、piece 都不能這樣用。
teach a lesson「給人上一課、教人道理」，冒號後面說明道理。date、piece、half 都不能接道理。

passages.zh: 在電影《動物方城市》裡，一隻叫茱蒂．哈柏的小兔子有一個大夢想：到大城市當警察。但對一隻小兔子來說，這並不容易。其他警察都是大象、獅子、犀牛這類大型動物，沒有人相信她做得到。上班第一天，局長不給她真正的案子，反而叫她去開停車罰單。茱蒂沒有放棄。後來，她遇到一隻聰明的狐狸尼克，兩人一起調查動物失蹤的案件。他們花了半個晚上開車在城裡到處尋找線索。就在他們找到答案的那一刻，大家終於相信茱蒂了。這部電影教我們重要的一課：不管體型大小，每個人都可以成為自己想成為的人。

passages.title: 端午節立蛋
passages.text: On Dragon Boat Festival, many people in Taiwan try to make raw eggs stand up at exactly twelve noon. People say it's {1} to do at that time because of the sun. This year, our science teacher took our class to the playground, and we formed small {2} of three. Each group got five eggs. At exactly that {3}, when the clock said 12:00, everyone bent down and tried. My egg fell three times. The fourth time, it stood for {4} a minute before it rolled away. Some groups did better, and one girl made all five eggs stand up! Then our teacher surprised us. She took out an egg and made it stand up at 12:30. "The {5} and the time don't matter," she said. "You can do this any day of the year. The real secret is patience."

blanks.why: It's easy to…「做…很簡單」：大家說端午節中午很容易立蛋。dead、half 放在這裡不通；own 不能單獨放在 it's 後面。
form groups of three「組成三人小組」。pieces、dates、lessons 都不能由人組成。
at that moment「在那一刻」：時鐘指著十二點的那一刻。piece、date、lesson 都不能表示時間點。
half a minute「半分鐘」。piece、group、date 都不能接 a minute 表示時間長度。
the date「日期」：老師說日期和時間都不重要，哪天都可以立蛋。piece、group、half 和 the time 並列意思不通。

passages.zh: 端午節時，台灣很多人會試著在正中午十二點讓生雞蛋站起來。大家說那個時間因為太陽的關係，立蛋很容易。今年，自然老師帶我們班到操場，我們組成三人一組的小組，每組拿到五顆蛋。就在時鐘指著十二點整的那一刻，大家彎下腰開始嘗試。我的蛋倒了三次，第四次站了半分鐘才滾走。有些組比較厲害，有一個女生還讓五顆蛋全都站起來了！接著老師給我們一個驚喜：她拿出一顆蛋，在十二點半讓它站了起來。「日期和時間都不重要，」她說，「一年裡哪一天都做得到，真正的祕訣是耐心。」

passages.title: 裝死的負鼠
passages.text: When an opossum is in danger, it does something very strange: it plays {1}. It falls on its side, closes its eyes, and opens its mouth. It doesn't move for {2} an hour, sometimes even longer. It even makes a bad smell, like a dead animal. Most hunters, such as foxes, only want to eat animals that are alive, so they walk away. It's an {3} way for the opossum to stay safe. It doesn't need to run or fight. Not long ago, a {4} of scientists studied this behavior. They found that the opossum can't really control it. It happens in a {5}, like fainting, when the animal is very scared. After the danger is gone, the opossum slowly wakes up and walks away as if nothing happened. I think it would be a useful trick on test days.

blanks.why: play dead「裝死」是固定片語。easy、half、own 都不能和 play 這樣搭配。
half an hour「半小時」。piece、group、date 都不能接 an hour 表示時間。
an easy way「一個簡單的方法」：不用跑也不用打，就能保護自己。dead way、own way（前面不能用 an）、half way 放在這裡都不通。
a group of scientists「一群科學家」。piece、date、half of scientists 都不能表示一群人。
in a moment「一瞬間」：負鼠嚇到時一瞬間就倒下。piece、lesson、date 都不能接在 in a 後面表示「一瞬間」。

passages.zh: 負鼠遇到危險時，會做一件很奇怪的事：裝死。牠會側身倒下、閉上眼睛、張開嘴巴，半個小時都不動，有時甚至更久。牠還會發出難聞的味道，就像死掉的動物一樣。大部分的獵食者，像是狐狸，只想吃活的動物，所以就走開了。對負鼠來說，這是保護自己的簡單方法，不用逃跑也不用打架。不久前，一群科學家研究了這種行為，發現負鼠其實無法控制它。當牠非常害怕時，這件事會在一瞬間發生，就像昏倒一樣。危險過去後，負鼠會慢慢醒來，若無其事地走開。我覺得這招在考試那天應該很好用。

passages.title: 黃老師的最後一堂課
passages.text: Ms. Huang has taught English at our school for thirty years. Last Friday, she gave her last {1} before she retired. Instead of teaching from the textbook, she told us about her {2}. When she was our age, her family was poor, and she had to work at a noodle shop after school. Her {3} was to become a singer, but her parents wanted her to be a teacher. Then she sang an old English song for us. Her voice was beautiful, and for a {4}, the whole class was completely silent. At the end of the class, she gave each of us a small {5} of paper with a message on it. Mine said, "Be kind. It's easy, and it's free." Some students cried. I put the paper in my wallet, and I read it whenever I have a bad day.

blanks.why: give a lesson「上課」：黃老師退休前上了最後一堂課。piece、half、date 都不能表示「一堂課」。
her past「她的過去」：老師講她以前的事。piece、group、half 都不能這樣用。
Her dream was to…「她的夢想是…」。date、piece、half 都不能接 was to become 表示想做的事。
for a moment「一時之間」：全班一下子安靜下來。lesson、date、group 不能接在 for a 後面表示短時間。
a small piece of paper「一小張紙」。group、date、half of paper 都不通。

passages.zh: 黃老師在我們學校教了三十年英文。上星期五，她在退休前上了最後一堂課。她沒有照課本教，而是跟我們講她以前的事。她跟我們一樣大的時候，家裡很窮，放學後得去麵店打工。她的夢想是當歌手，但爸媽希望她當老師。接著她為我們唱了一首英文老歌，她的歌聲很美，全班一時之間完全安靜下來。下課前，她給我們每人一小張紙條，上面寫著一句話。我的寫著：「要善良。這很簡單，而且不用錢。」有些同學哭了。我把紙條放進錢包，每次心情不好時就拿出來讀。

passages.title: 半價的遊戲
passages.text: Last weekend, my favorite video game was on sale for {1} price. I had been waiting for this {2} for months, so I bought it the second the sale started. The game is about adventure. You lead a small {3} of explorers through jungles and deserts to find hidden treasure. The first few levels were {4}, and I finished them in an hour. But then the game became much harder. In one level, a giant snake chased my team, and I failed twenty times! I wanted to throw my controller, but I kept trying. Late on Sunday night, I finally beat the snake. My little brother saw me playing and wants to buy the game, too. "Hurry up," I told him. "Don't miss the {5}. The sale ends this Sunday at midnight!"

blanks.why: half price「半價」。piece、group、date 都不能接 price 表示打折。
wait for this moment「等這一刻」：我等這個時刻等了好幾個月。lesson、piece、group 都不能表示等待的時刻。
a small group of explorers「一小隊探險家」。piece、date、lesson of explorers 都不能表示一群人。
easy「簡單的」：前幾關一小時就破完了，後面才變難。dead、past 形容關卡都不通；own 不能單獨放在 were 後面。
Don't miss the date.「別錯過日期」：特價到星期天午夜結束。piece、half、group 和後面說明的截止時間接不起來。

passages.zh: 上週末，我最喜歡的電玩遊戲打半價。我等這一刻已經等了好幾個月，所以特價一開始我就馬上買了。這是一款冒險遊戲，你要帶領一小隊探險家穿越叢林和沙漠，尋找藏起來的寶藏。前幾關很簡單，我一個小時就破完了。但後來遊戲變得難多了。有一關，一條巨蛇一直追我的隊伍，我失敗了二十次！我很想把手把丟出去，但還是繼續嘗試。星期天深夜，我終於打敗了那條蛇。弟弟看到我在玩，也想買。「快一點，」我跟他說，「別錯過日期，特價這個星期天午夜就結束了！」

passages.title: 九份老街
passages.text: Last weekend, our {1} of six friends took a bus to Jiufen, an old mountain town in New Taipei. Walking on the narrow old street felt like going back to the {2}. There were red lanterns, old tea houses, and small shops selling traditional snacks. We each bought a {3} of peanut candy wrapped in a thin pancake with ice cream. It was sweet and crunchy! The street was so crowded on the weekend that walking was not {4}. Sometimes we couldn't move at all. My friend Rita almost lost her phone in the crowd. Then we spent {5} an hour looking for a seat at a tea house with a view of the sea. When we finally sat down and drank hot tea, the sun was going down over the mountains. It was worth all the waiting.

blanks.why: our group of six friends「我們這群六個朋友」。piece、date、half of six friends 都不能表示一群人。
go back to the past「回到過去」：老街讓人覺得像回到從前。piece、group、half 都不能這樣用。
a piece of…「一塊…」：一塊花生糖。group、date、half 都不能和 a … of peanut candy 這樣表示「一塊」。
not easy「不容易」：人太多，走路很困難。dead、half 形容走路不通；own 不能單獨放在 was not 後面。
half an hour「半小時」。piece、date、group 都不能接 an hour 表示時間。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們六個朋友搭公車去新北的山城九份。走在狹窄的老街上，感覺像回到了過去。那裡有紅燈籠、老茶館，還有賣傳統點心的小店。我們每人買了一份花生捲冰淇淋，薄餅包著花生糖和冰淇淋，又甜又脆！週末老街人好多，走路一點都不容易，有時候根本動不了。我朋友 Rita 還差點在人群裡弄丟手機。接著我們花了半小時，才在一間看得到海的茶館找到位子。等我們終於坐下來喝熱茶時，太陽正從山後落下。一切的等待都值得了。

passages.title: 爸爸的搖滾夢
passages.text: My dad works in an office now, but in the {1}, he played the guitar in a rock band. Mom told me his {2} was to become a rock star. He played in small clubs every weekend until he got his first office job at twenty-three. Last Saturday, I found his old guitar behind the sofa and asked him to play. At first, his fingers were slow and stiff because he hadn't played for {3} his life. But after a few songs, he started to smile, and for a {4}, he looked young again. Then he played a slow love song. Mom stopped washing the dishes and listened. "That's the song he played on our first {5}," she whispered to me. Now Dad plays every Saturday night, and I'm learning too. Maybe one day we can start our own family band.

blanks.why: in the past「以前、過去」：爸爸以前在搖滾樂團彈吉他。piece、group、half 都不能和 in the 搭配表示「以前」。
his dream was to…「他的夢想是…」。date、piece、half 都不能接 was to become 表示想做的事。
half his life「他人生的一半」：爸爸有半輩子沒彈了。piece、group、date his life 都不通。
for a moment「一時之間、那一瞬間」。lesson、date、piece 不能接在 for a 後面表示短時間。
our first date「我們的第一次約會」。piece、half、group 都不能表示「約會」。

passages.zh: 我爸爸現在在辦公室上班，但他以前在搖滾樂團裡彈吉他。媽媽告訴我，他的夢想是當搖滾巨星。他每個週末都在小場地表演，直到二十三歲找到第一份上班族工作。上星期六，我在沙發後面找到他的舊吉他，請他彈給我聽。一開始，他的手指又慢又僵硬，因為他已經有半輩子沒彈了。但彈了幾首歌之後，他開始露出笑容，那一瞬間，他看起來又變年輕了。接著他彈了一首慢慢的情歌，媽媽停下手邊洗碗的工作聽著。「那是我們第一次約會時他彈的歌。」她小聲對我說。現在爸爸每個星期六晚上都會彈，我也在學。也許有一天，我們可以組一個家庭樂團。

passages.title: 光盤小隊
passages.text: At our school, students eat lunch in their classrooms. Every day, about {1} of the vegetables end up in the trash. Our class thought this was a big waste, so we formed a small {2} called the "Clean Plate Team." Our plan was {3}: everyone takes only what they can finish. If you are still hungry, you can always come back for another {4} of chicken or another spoon of rice. We also made a chart on the wall to record how much food we threw away each day. At first, some students complained, but soon everyone joined in. After one month, our class's food trash was less than a quarter of what it used to be. The principal was so impressed that she asked us to talk at the morning meeting. Our teacher said we taught the whole school an important {5}.

blanks.why: half of the vegetables「一半的蔬菜」。piece、group、date of the vegetables 都不能表示「一半」。
form a small group「組成一個小團體」。piece、date、lesson 都不能由人組成並取名字。
easy「簡單的」：計畫很簡單，冒號後面說明內容。dead、past 形容計畫都不通；own 不能單獨放在 was 後面。
another piece of chicken「再一塊雞肉」。group、date、lesson of chicken 都不通。
teach + 人 + a lesson「給某人上了一課」。date、piece、half 都不能接 important 表示道理。

passages.zh: 我們學校的學生都在教室吃午餐。每天大約有一半的蔬菜被丟進垃圾桶。我們班覺得這是很大的浪費，所以組了一個叫「光盤小隊」的小團體。我們的計畫很簡單：每個人只拿自己吃得完的份量。如果還餓，隨時可以再拿一塊雞肉或再盛一匙飯。我們也在牆上做了一張圖表，記錄每天丟掉多少食物。一開始有些同學抱怨，但很快大家都加入了。一個月後，我們班的廚餘不到原來的四分之一。校長印象非常深刻，還請我們在朝會上分享。老師說，我們給全校上了重要的一課。

passages.title: 最後一隻龍
passages.text: Long ago, people believed that all the dragons in the kingdom were {1}. No one had seen one for a hundred years. One day, a girl named Lin found a strange egg in a cave near her village. It was warm, and {2} of it was covered in gold. She carried it home carefully and put it next to the fire. At that very {3}, the egg began to crack. A tiny red dragon came out and looked up at her. Taking care of a baby dragon was not {4}. It ate twenty fish a day, slept on her bed, and burned her curtains twice. But Lin loved it. Years later, the dragon grew as big as a house. When Lin and her dragon flew over the kingdom, people looked up in surprise. Dragons were not just a thing of the {5} after all.

blanks.why: dead「死的、絕跡的」：大家以為龍全都死了，一百年沒人見過。easy、half 放在這裡不通；own 不能單獨放在 were 後面。
half of it「它的一半」：蛋有一半是金色的。piece、group、date of it 都不能表示「一半」。
at that moment「就在那一刻」：放到火邊的那一刻蛋開始裂開。lesson、date、group 都不能表示時間點。
not easy「不容易」：小龍很會吃、還燒了窗簾，照顧牠不容易。dead、half 不通；own 不能單獨放在 was not 後面。
a thing of the past「過去的東西、已經不存在的事物」。piece、group、half 都不能和 a thing of the 這樣搭配。

passages.zh: 很久以前，人們相信王國裡所有的龍都已經死光了，一百年來沒有人看過龍。有一天，一個叫小林的女孩在村子附近的山洞裡發現一顆奇怪的蛋。蛋是溫的，有一半覆蓋著金色。她小心地把蛋抱回家，放在火爐旁邊。就在那一刻，蛋開始裂開，一隻紅色的小龍鑽了出來，抬頭看著她。照顧小龍並不容易：牠一天要吃二十條魚、睡在她床上，還燒了她的窗簾兩次。但小林很愛牠。幾年後，龍長得跟房子一樣大。當小林和她的龍飛過王國上空時，人們驚訝地抬起頭。原來，龍並不只是過去的傳說。

passages.title: 公園裡的瘦狗
passages.text: On my way to school, I always walk {1} a small park near the MRT station. There is a thin brown dog that sleeps under the slide there. One cold morning, it looked so hungry that I gave it a {2} of my sandwich. For a {3}, it just looked at me. Then it ate the sandwich in one bite and wagged its tail. After that, the dog waited for me at the park gate every morning. I wanted to take it home, but my apartment doesn't allow pets. Finding it a home was not {4}. I put its photo online, but nobody answered for weeks. Finally, a {5} of volunteers from an animal shelter came and took it in. Last month, a family with two kids adopted it. They sent me a photo. The dog isn't thin anymore, and it has a new name: Sandwich.

blanks.why: walk past + 地方「走過、經過…」。than、because、during 都不能接地方表示「經過」。
a piece of my sandwich「我三明治的一塊」。group、date、half 都不能這樣用（half 前面不能用 a 接 of my sandwich 表示一塊）。
for a moment「一下子」：狗先看了我一下。lesson、date、group 不能接在 for a 後面表示短時間。
not easy「不容易」：網路上貼照片好幾週都沒人回應。dead、half 不通；own 不能單獨放在 was not 後面。
a group of volunteers「一群志工」。piece、date、lesson of volunteers 都不能表示一群人。

passages.zh: 上學途中，我都會經過捷運站旁的一座小公園。那裡有一隻瘦瘦的棕色狗，總是睡在溜滑梯下面。一個寒冷的早上，牠看起來好餓，我就分了一塊三明治給牠。牠先看了我一下，接著一口吃掉，還搖起了尾巴。從那之後，那隻狗每天早上都在公園門口等我。我很想帶牠回家，但我們的公寓不能養寵物。要幫牠找到家並不容易，我把牠的照片貼到網路上，好幾個星期都沒有人回應。最後，動物收容所的一群志工來把牠帶走了。上個月，一個有兩個小孩的家庭領養了牠，還傳了照片給我。那隻狗已經不瘦了，還有了新名字：三明治。

passages.title: 忘了寫日期
passages.text: I have a bad habit: I always {1} to write my name and the date on my homework. My English teacher, Mr. Lee, reminds me almost every week. "Writing the {2} takes only a moment," he says. Last Tuesday, we had a math test. It was very {3}, and I knew every answer. I finished in twenty minutes and felt proud of myself. But when I got my test back, there was a big red note at the top: "No name, no date!" The teacher gave me only {4} of the points. I was so angry with myself. Now I have a new rule. Before I start any test, I write my name and the date at the top of every {5} of paper. Mr. Lee smiled when he saw my last homework. "Finally!" he said.

blanks.why: forget to + 原形動詞「忘記去做…」：我老是忘記寫名字和日期。paint、cry、welcome 後面不能接 to write 表示這個意思。
write the date「寫日期」。piece、group、half 都不是寫在作業上的資訊。
easy「簡單的」：考試很簡單，我每題都會。dead、past 形容考試不通；own 不能單獨放在 very 後面。
half of the points「一半的分數」。piece、group、date of the points 都不能表示「一半」。
a piece of paper「一張紙」。group、date、lesson of paper 都不通。

passages.zh: 我有一個壞習慣：老是忘記在作業上寫名字和日期。英文老師李老師幾乎每個星期都要提醒我。「寫日期只要花一下子。」他說。上星期二我們考數學，題目非常簡單，我每題都會，二十分鐘就寫完了，覺得自己好厲害。但考卷發回來時，最上面有一行紅色大字：「沒寫名字，沒寫日期！」老師只給了我一半的分數，我真的很氣自己。現在我有一條新規定：每次考試開始前，我都先在每一張紙的最上面寫好名字和日期。李老師看到我最近的作業時笑著說：「終於！」

passages.title: 金魚小紅
passages.text: One Sunday morning, I found my goldfish, Little Red, floating at the top of his tank. He was {1}. I had him for {2} of my life. I won him at a night market when I was seven, and now I am fourteen. For a {3}, I couldn't move or say anything. Then I started to {4}. Mom came in and sat beside me. She didn't say "It's only a fish." She just held my hand. Later, we buried Little Red under the tree in our garden, and I put a small stone on top with his name on it. That night, Mom told me, "It's never {5} to say goodbye, but your sadness shows how much you cared about him." I still miss Little Red, but now when I see the tree, I smile instead of feeling sad.

blanks.why: dead「死的」：金魚浮在水面上，已經死了。easy、half 放在這裡不通；own 不能單獨放在 was 後面。
half of my life「我一半的人生」：七歲養到十四歲。piece、group、date of my life 都不通。
for a moment「一時之間」：我一時動不了也說不出話。lesson、date、group 不能接在 for a 後面表示短時間。
start to cry「開始哭」。paint、welcome、marry 後面沒有受詞，放在這裡都不通。
It's never easy to…「做…從來都不容易」：說再見從來都不容易。dead、half 放在這裡不通；own 不能用在這個句型。

passages.zh: 一個星期天早上，我發現我的金魚小紅浮在魚缸的水面上，牠死了。我養了牠半輩子：七歲那年在夜市撈到牠，現在我十四歲了。一時之間，我動不了也說不出話，接著就哭了起來。媽媽走進來坐在我旁邊，她沒有說「只不過是一條魚」，只是握著我的手。後來，我們把小紅埋在院子的樹下，我在上面放了一顆寫著牠名字的小石頭。那天晚上媽媽告訴我：「說再見從來都不容易，但你的難過正說明了你有多在乎牠。」我還是很想念小紅，但現在看到那棵樹時，我會微笑，而不是難過。

passages.title: 排隊買限量公仔
passages.text: Last Saturday, I joined a long line outside a toy store at five in the morning. In front of me was a {1} of fans wearing T-shirts from the same cartoon. Everyone was waiting for the new figures, which were sold on that {2} only. Getting one was not {3}: the store had only fifty of them, and more than two hundred people were in line. Some people brought chairs and blankets. A kind woman next to me shared her hot tea. After waiting for six and a {4} hours, I walked into the store. The worker held up the very last box. "This one is yours," she said. At that {5}, I felt like the luckiest person in the world. My legs were tired, but I hugged the box all the way home on the MRT.

blanks.why: a group of fans「一群粉絲」。piece、date、half of fans 都不能表示一群人。
on that date only「只在那一天」：公仔只在那天販售。piece、half、lesson 都不能接在 on that 後面表示日子。
not easy「不容易」：只有五十個，排隊的卻有兩百多人。dead、past 形容買公仔不通；own 不能單獨放在 was not 後面。
six and a half hours「六個半小時」。piece、date、group 都不能用在 and a ___ hours 表示時間。
at that moment「在那一刻」。lesson、date、piece 都不能表示時間點。

passages.zh: 上星期六清晨五點，我在一家玩具店外面排起了長長的隊伍。我前面是一群穿著同一部卡通 T 恤的粉絲。大家都在等新出的公仔，它們只在那一天販售。要買到一個並不容易：店裡只有五十個，排隊的人卻超過兩百個。有人帶了椅子和毯子，旁邊一位好心的阿姨還分我喝熱茶。等了六個半小時後，我終於走進店裡。店員舉起最後一盒說：「這是你的。」那一刻，我覺得自己是全世界最幸運的人。我的腳很痠，但在捷運上一路緊緊抱著盒子回家。

passages.title: 第一堂鋼琴課
passages.text: My first piano {1} was a disaster. Before it started, I thought playing the piano would be {2}. After all, you just press the keys, right? But my teacher, Ms. Lin, didn't let me play any songs at all. For the whole hour, she only let me practice one short {3} of music with my right hand. My fingers kept hitting the wrong keys, and I wanted to quit. "Practice for {4} an hour every day," Ms. Lin said. "Don't play fast. Play right." I followed her advice, even on days when I didn't want to. Six months later, I played at the school concert. My hands were shaking, but I didn't make a single mistake. At the {5} I finished, everyone clapped, and I saw Ms. Lin smiling in the front row.

blanks.why: piano lesson「鋼琴課」。piece、date、group 都不能接在 piano 後面表示上課。
easy「簡單的」：我以為彈鋼琴只要按琴鍵就好。dead、half 放在這裡不通；own 不能單獨放在 be 後面。
a piece of music「一首曲子」。group、date、half of music 都不通。
half an hour「半小時」：每天練習半小時。piece、group、date 都不能接 an hour 表示時間。
at the moment + 子句「在…的那一刻」：我彈完的那一刻大家拍手。date、group、piece 都不能這樣用。

passages.zh: 我的第一堂鋼琴課簡直是一場災難。上課前，我以為彈鋼琴很簡單，不就是按琴鍵嗎？但林老師完全不讓我彈歌，一整個小時都只讓我用右手練習一小段曲子。我的手指一直按錯鍵，讓我很想放棄。「每天練習半小時，」林老師說，「不要彈快，要彈對。」我照著她的建議做，就算不想練的日子也一樣。六個月後，我在學校音樂會上表演。我的手在發抖，但一個錯都沒有。我彈完的那一刻，大家都拍手，我看到林老師坐在第一排微笑。

passages.title: 如果能回到過去
passages.text: If I could travel to the {1}, I wouldn't visit kings or famous battles. I would choose a {2} about seventy years ago and visit my great-grandparents' small farm in Changhua. My {3} is to see how people lived without phones, cars, or even electricity. Grandma says life back then wasn't {4}. Her parents got up before the sun rose and worked in the rice fields all day. Children walked an hour to school without shoes. Meat was so expensive that her family only ate a small {5} of pork during Chinese New Year. But she also says people were closer to each other. Neighbors shared food, helped build each other's houses, and sat outside together on summer nights. I think I would learn a lot there. Of course, I would also bring them some instant noodles.

blanks.why: travel to the past「回到過去」。piece、group、half 都不能這樣用。
choose a date「選一個日子」：選七十年前的某一天。lesson、piece、half 都不能接 about seventy years ago 表示時間。
My dream is to…「我的夢想是…」。date、piece、half 都不能接 is to see 表示想做的事。
wasn't easy「不容易、很辛苦」：天沒亮就起床工作。dead、half 不通；own 不能單獨放在 wasn't 後面。
a small piece of pork「一小塊豬肉」。group、date、half 都不能這樣接 of pork 表示「一塊」。

passages.zh: 如果我能回到過去，我不會去見國王或看有名的戰役。我會選大約七十年前的某一天，去拜訪我曾祖父母在彰化的小農場。我的夢想是看看沒有手機、沒有車，甚至沒有電的時候，人們是怎麼生活的。奶奶說那時的生活很辛苦。她的爸媽天還沒亮就起床，在稻田裡工作一整天；小孩光著腳走一個小時去上學。肉很貴，她家只有過年時才吃得到一小塊豬肉。但她也說，那時人和人比較親近：鄰居會分享食物、互相幫忙蓋房子，夏天晚上還會一起坐在外面聊天。我想我在那裡會學到很多。當然，我也會帶幾包泡麵給他們。

passages.title: 媽媽的團購群組
passages.text: My mom is in an online {1} of neighbors who buy things together. Buying in large amounts is cheaper, so they can often save almost {2} the price. Last month, the group ordered fifty kilos of mangoes from a farm in Tainan, and Mom was in charge. The delivery {3} was Friday afternoon, so I came home early to help. When the truck arrived, I couldn't believe how many boxes there were. Carrying them up to the fifth floor wasn't {4}, and we don't have an elevator! After that, neighbors came to our door one by one to pick up their mangoes. Each family gave us a big "thank you," and one aunt even gave us a cake. But Mom ordered too many for us. For the next week, we ate a {5} of mango with every meal, even with fried rice.

blanks.why: an online group of neighbors「鄰居的網路群組」。piece、date、half of neighbors 都不能表示一群人。
save half the price「省下一半的價錢」。piece、date、group the price 都不通。
the delivery date「送貨日期」：星期五下午送到。piece、lesson、group 都不能接在 delivery 後面表示日子。
wasn't easy「不容易」：搬到沒有電梯的五樓很辛苦。dead、past 不通；own 不能單獨放在 wasn't 後面。
a piece of mango「一塊芒果」。group、date、lesson of mango 都不通。

passages.zh: 我媽媽加入了一個鄰居的網路團購群組，大家一起買東西。大量購買比較便宜，所以常常可以省下將近一半的價錢。上個月，群組向台南一座農場訂了五十公斤的芒果，由媽媽負責。送貨日期是星期五下午，所以我提早回家幫忙。貨車一到，我簡直不敢相信有那麼多箱。要把它們搬上五樓真的不容易，我們家又沒有電梯！之後，鄰居一個一個到我家門口領芒果，每一家都大聲道謝，還有一位阿姨送我們一個蛋糕。但媽媽幫我們家訂太多了，接下來一個星期，我們每一餐都要吃一塊芒果，連配炒飯也是。

passages.title: 颱風後的老榕樹
passages.text: There is an old banyan tree in the middle of our school's playground. It is over a hundred years old, and generations of students have played under it. Last summer, a strong typhoon hit our town. The next morning, the tree was lying on the ground, and some people thought it was {1}. Its trunk had broken into two {2}. Workers wanted to cut it up and take it away. But a {3} of students and teachers didn't give up. They asked a tree doctor for help. Together, they stood the bigger {4} of the tree up again and tied it to strong poles. Every day, someone watered it and checked its leaves. For three months, nothing happened. Then one morning, at the {5} we saw a tiny green leaf on a branch, everyone on the playground cheered. The old tree was alive!

blanks.why: dead「死的」：大樹倒在地上，有人以為它死了。easy、half 放在這裡不通；own 不能單獨放在 was 後面。
break into two pieces「斷成兩截」。groups、dates、lessons 都不能說樹幹斷成幾段。
a group of students and teachers「一群師生」。piece、date、lesson of students 都不能表示一群人。
the bigger half「比較大的那一半」：樹斷成兩截，把大的那半截重新立起來。lesson、group、date of the tree 都不通。
at the moment + 子句「在…的那一刻」：看到新葉的那一刻大家歡呼。lesson、date、group 都不能這樣用。

passages.zh: 我們學校操場中間有一棵老榕樹，已經一百多歲了，一代又一代的學生都在樹下玩過。去年夏天，一個強烈颱風襲擊我們的小鎮。隔天早上，大樹倒在地上，有些人以為它已經死了。它的樹幹斷成了兩截，工人想把它鋸開運走。但一群師生沒有放棄，他們請樹醫生來幫忙，一起把比較大的那半截重新立起來，綁在堅固的柱子上。每天都有人幫它澆水、檢查葉子。三個月過去了，什麼都沒發生。直到某天早上，大家看到樹枝上冒出一片小小的綠葉，那一刻，操場上的每個人都歡呼了起來。老樹還活著！

passages.title: 烘焙課的餅乾
passages.text: Last weekend, my best friend and I took a baking {1} at a small café. The teacher told us that making cookies is {2} if you follow the recipe carefully. There were ten students, and each {3} of two had to make twenty chocolate cookies. My friend measured the flour, and I mixed the butter and sugar. Everything went well until we put the cookies in the oven. We started talking about our favorite singer and {4} to check the timer. When we finally opened the oven, black smoke came out! {5} of our cookies were burned. We were so embarrassed, but the teacher only laughed. "Everyone burns cookies once," she said. We ate the good ones and gave the burned ones a funny name: "Midnight Cookies." Next time, I'll keep my eyes on the oven.

blanks.why: a baking lesson「烘焙課」。piece、date、group 都不能接在 baking 後面表示上課。
easy「簡單的」：照著食譜做就很簡單。dead、past 形容做餅乾不通；own 不能單獨放在 is 後面。
each group of two「每兩人一組」。piece、date、lesson of two 都不能表示一組人。
forget to + 原形動詞「忘記去做…」：聊天聊到忘了看計時器。painted、cried、welcomed 後面不能接 to check 表示這個意思。
Half of…「…的一半」：一半的餅乾烤焦了。Piece、Group、Date of our cookies were burned 都不通。

passages.zh: 上週末，我和最好的朋友在一家小咖啡廳上了一堂烘焙課。老師說，只要仔細照著食譜做，做餅乾很簡單。全班有十個學生，每兩人一組要做二十片巧克力餅乾。我朋友量麵粉，我負責攪拌奶油和糖。一切都很順利，直到我們把餅乾放進烤箱。我們開始聊最喜歡的歌手，結果忘了看計時器。等我們終於打開烤箱時，黑煙冒了出來！一半的餅乾都烤焦了。我們很尷尬，但老師只是笑著說：「每個人都烤焦過一次餅乾。」我們吃掉了好的那些，還幫烤焦的取了一個好笑的名字：「午夜餅乾」。下次我會一直盯著烤箱。

passages.title: 射門的那一刻
passages.text: Our school soccer team had one {1}: to win the city cup. We had lost in the final two years in a row. This year, we got to the final again. It was a hot afternoon, and the first {2} ended 0–0. Scoring was not {3} because the other team's goalkeeper was amazing. He stopped every shot we made. In the second half, both teams were very tired. Then, in the last minute, my teammate passed me the ball. I ran forward and kicked it as hard as I could. The ball flew {4} the goalkeeper's hands and into the net! That {5} was the happiest of my life. My teammates jumped on me, and our coach cried like a baby. We finally brought the cup home, and now it stands in the school's front hall.

blanks.why: have one dream「有一個夢想」，冒號後面說明是贏得市長盃。date、piece、half 都不能接「想贏得獎盃」。
the first half「上半場」。piece、date、group 都不能表示比賽的上半段。
not easy「不容易」：對方守門員很厲害，很難得分。dead、past 不通；own 不能單獨放在 was not 後面。
fly past + 物「從…旁邊飛過」：球飛過守門員的手進網。than、because、during 都不能接 the goalkeeper's hands 表示「經過」。
That moment was…「那一刻是…」：進球那一刻是我人生最快樂的時刻。lesson、date、piece 都不能表示「進球的那個時刻」。

passages.zh: 我們學校足球隊只有一個夢想：贏得市長盃。我們已經連續兩年在決賽輸球了。今年，我們又打進了決賽。那是個炎熱的下午，上半場打成零比零。要得分不容易，因為對方的守門員太厲害了，我們每一次射門都被他擋下來。下半場兩隊都累壞了。就在最後一分鐘，隊友把球傳給我，我往前衝，用盡全力一踢，球從守門員的手邊飛過，進網了！那一刻是我人生中最快樂的時刻。隊友們全撲到我身上，教練哭得像個小孩。我們終於把獎盃帶回家，現在它就擺在學校的大廳裡。

passages.title: 和筆友見面
passages.text: My pen pal Sofia lives in Spain. We have written letters and emails to each other for two and a {1} years, but we had never met. This summer, her family planned a trip to Asia, and we finally chose a {2} to meet: August 10. On that day, I went to the airport with a small {3} of friends and a big sign that said "Bienvenida, Sofia!" It means "Welcome" in Spanish. At the {4} I saw her walk out of the gate, I forgot all my English! I just stood there and smiled like a fool. Sofia laughed and gave me a big hug. But talking soon became {5}, and we couldn't stop. We took her to eat beef noodles and bubble tea, and she loved both. Before she left, she said, "Next time, you come to Spain!"

blanks.why: two and a half years「兩年半」。piece、group、date 都不能用在 and a ___ years 表示時間。
choose a date to meet「選一個見面的日子」，冒號後面是 8 月 10 日。lesson、piece、group 都不是日期。
a small group of friends「一小群朋友」。piece、date、lesson of friends 都不能表示一群人。
at the moment + 子句「在…的那一刻」：看到她走出來的那一刻我忘光英文。lesson、date、piece 都不能這樣用。
become easy「變得容易」：後來聊天變得很輕鬆。dead、past 放在這裡都不通；own 不能單獨放在 became 後面。

passages.zh: 我的筆友 Sofia 住在西班牙。我們互相寫信和電子郵件已經兩年半了，卻從來沒見過面。今年暑假，她家計畫到亞洲旅行，我們終於選好了見面的日子：8 月 10 日。那天，我和一小群朋友帶著一張大牌子去機場，上面寫著「Bienvenida, Sofia!」，是西班牙文的「歡迎」。看到她走出閘門的那一刻，我的英文全忘光了！我只是站在那裡，像個傻瓜一樣笑。Sofia 笑著給了我一個大大的擁抱。不過很快地，聊天就變得很輕鬆，我們聊個不停。我們帶她去吃牛肉麵、喝珍珠奶茶，兩樣她都很喜歡。離開前她說：「下次換你來西班牙！」
